title: George Carlin on soft language
summary: A clip from George Carlin's 1990 special 'Doin' It Again' in which he describes how American English has been sterilized with euphemisms, using examples such as shell shock becoming PTSD.
why: HN reaches for this clip whenever a thread involves euphemism or corporate and sanitized phrasing.

quote.text: George Carlin has a funny skit about how messaging has gotten softer over the years that you might enjoy.
